'''September 2000 Smyrna tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Champion Cards & Comics, Smyrna, Georgia on 23 September 2000. [[James McNash]] won it. It is known from James McNash's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1261">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-23-smryna-georgia-9-23-00d1261/ smryna-georgia-9-23-00], DeckTech (James "kmcnash" McNash, 23 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-23-smryna-georgia-9-23-00d1261/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Champion Cards & Comics, Smyrna, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Death Star II Closed Environment]]
* '''Winner:''' [[James McNash]]
